content: As illustrated in Figure FIGREF9, BRLM stacks shared encoder over both side sentences separately. In particular, we design two network structures for BRLM, which are divided into Hard Alignment (BRLM-HA) and Soft Alignment (BRLM-SA) according to the way of generating the alignment information. These two structures actually extend MLM into a bilingual scenario, with the difference that BRLM leverages external aligner tool or additional attention layer to explicitly introduce alignment information during model training.
